INSERT INTO ai_alert_record (alert_no, rule_id, rule_code, rule_name, severity, source_type, first_source_id, last_source_id, workflow_id, workflow_code, workflow_name, error_code, error_message, dedup_key, active_key, status, occurrence_count, first_occurred_at, last_occurred_at, created_at, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{record.alertNo}, #{record.ruleId}, #{record.ruleCode}, #{record.ruleName}, #{record.severity}, #{record.sourceType}, #{record.firstSourceId}, #{record.lastSourceId}, #{record.workflowId}, #{record.workflowCode}, #{record.workflowName}, #{record.errorCode}, #{record.errorMessage}, #{record.dedupKey}, #{record.activeKey}, #{record.status}, #{record.occurrenceCount}, #{record.firstOccurredAt}, #{record.lastOccurredAt}, #{record.createdAt}, #{record.updatedAt} ) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE last_source_id = VALUES(last_source_id), workflow_id = VALUES(workflow_id), workflow_code = VALUES(workflow_code), workflow_name = VALUES(workflow_name), severity = VALUES(severity), error_code = VALUES(error_code), error_message = VALUES(error_message),
occurrence_count = occurrence_count + 1, last_occurred_at = VALUES(last_occurred_at),

updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
